_comment: What one Runtime State record costs in the representation the store writes.
This file is a baseline, not a fixture: the numbers are produced by the real
encoder over the fixture in runtime_record_baseline_test.go, and they are
recorded here so that a change in the representation shows up as a diff
instead of silently moving the point ceiling underneath the compiler.
A failure here is not a reason to regenerate the file. It means the record
changed shape, and the ceilings in config.retainedPointCeilings() changed
with it - which is the event this baseline exists to make visible. Update
these numbers only together with the change that moved them, and say in the
One production reading, kept so the encoder can be checked against the
deployment rather than only against itself. A model that is only ever
compared with its own output cannot report that it has drifted.
